answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 21208 Country: Bangladesh Title: Can i spend the bank interest amount to pay income tax? Question: As salamu alaikum. Can i spend the bank interest amount to pay income tax? Answer ID: 21208 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 469/469/M=1431) If interest amount is received from government bank, it is allowed to pay it in income tax. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
